business_summary: Daisyo Corporation engages in the food and beverages business in Japan. The company also provides operational support and franchises stores. In addition, it rents and manages real estate, such as building tenants and subleases rented store properties, as well as provides pest control and sterilization services for restaurants, etc. Further, the company manufactures and sells bread under Miyabi brand; and sells tableware and cooking equipment. Further, it offers logistics services. Additionally, the company operates restaurant chain under Shoya, Taisho Suisan, and Nihonkai Syoya brands. The company was founded in 1968 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
